items.summary: Fix the backend authorization check for the `addCommentList` (Create Comment List) function in backend/main.mo so that it correctly recognizes the admin caller and allows comment list creation. The current error is 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add comment lists'. Apply the same admin principal check fix that was used to resolve the Live List and Settings authorization issues — ensure the admin identity/principal check is consistent across all admin-gated functions.

Fix the frontend actor construction in AdminComments.tsx so that all mutation calls (createCommentList, renameCommentList, deleteCommentList, addTemplatesToList, etc.) use the authenticated admin actor rather than the anonymous identity, consistent with the fix applied to AdminLiveList.tsx and AdminSettings.tsx.
